headline: NY high 11-13 is unsettled and its NWS sources conflict: the final CLI says 47 at 1:11 AM (below the 12:51 AM METAR of 48) while the preliminary CLI and DSM said 52 at 12:11 AM, so our 49-or-below lock (p 0.857) is a miss on the sheet but a hit if 47 stands. This branch fixes the afternoon blend, which put p 0.67 on 49-or-below from 15:40 to 17:55 with the exact floor already at 52.

findings.title: 11-13 high: final CLI contradicts preliminary and METAR
findings.evidence: CLINYC 202611140625: max 47 at 1:11 AM; prelim CLI and dsm 52 at 12:11 AM; IEM ASOS 00:51 48, 23:51 51; kalshi_ny.json actual 52 (truth_source observed), hit false, err -3.2; Kalshi KXHIGHNY-26NOV13 all closed, no result

findings.title: Afternoon blend put mass under the exact floor
findings.evidence: ny_high trail 11-13 15:40-17:55: dsm/cli 52, plain ladder 52-53 1.0, blended ours 49-or-below 0.672-0.686 (emp_w 0.75 on climb table centred at round(48.02)); replay after fix 0/0/1.0

findings.title: Boundary straddle is off in standard time
findings.evidence: kalshi_daily.py:895 'if not h0' returns None with h0 = 0 since 11-01; 11-13 front night 51 at 23:51, 48 at 00:51, prelim high 52 at 12:11 AM; bound at 00:56 on 48.795, p 0.857 on 49-or-below all day vs market 52-53
